facts.claim: Ikos Resorts' weddings page is titled 'Weddings in Ikos Aria' and describes Ikos Aria on the island of Kos as a wedding destination with a romantic setting and sea views, with an in-house wedding planner who can plan the entire event.

Ikos Aria's wedding planner coordinates the legal arrangements with the local Town Hall, helps submit documents for a civil wedding and obtain the marriage certificate, and can arrange accommodation for up to 30 guests.

At Ikos Aria the reading of vows can be arranged in one of the resort's designated wedding spots in the grounds; a legal ceremony needs officially translated documents and two witnesses of legal age, and the page tells couples to contact the Greek consulate in their home country because the Greek government sets the requirements, which can change without notice.
Ikos Resorts describes Ikos Aria as set within over 47 acres beside white sands on Kos, with everything included in the stay.
The Poseidonion Grand Hotel (Spetses) has an official weddings page presenting the hotel as a wedding venue for couples and their guests.
The Poseidonion Grand Hotel's weddings page says its Idolo Spa offers exclusive bridal packages; the page publishes no capacity, ceremony spaces or room block details.
Miraggio Thermal Spa Resort (Kanistro, Paliouri, Halkidiki) has an official weddings page offering ceremonies and receptions, from an intimate beach gathering to a grand ballroom event.

Miraggio says ceremonies can be arranged in a variety of settings, from beachfront moments to cocktail receptions and formal banquets, with numerous dining locations and bars overlooking the Aegean Sea.
Miraggio lists extra wedding services: floral decoration by Fiorentino Luxury Flower Services and professional photography services; the resort also has a private marina and the Myrthia Thermal Spa.

Nana Princess (Chersonissos, Crete, on the Aegean coast) has an official weddings page offering civil weddings on its private sandy beach, Greek Orthodox weddings in the private Chapel of St. George in the hotel grounds, symbolic weddings and vow renewals; it describes itself as suited to small to medium sized events.

Nana Princess offers exclusive use of the chosen room or venue for symbolic weddings, and lists reception options on the terrace of the Eternal Blue restaurant overlooking the bay of Stalis, a poolside reception at the Meat-In-Point restaurant seating up to 120 guests, and its Conference Hall for larger covered receptions.

Nana Princess warns that high-summer temperatures in Greece can reach 35 degrees C and recommends evening ceremony times: 16:00 to 18:00 in April, May and October; 18:00 to 20:00 in June to September; 18:30 to 20:00 in July and August.

Nana Princess publishes three named wedding packages (Deluxe Dream, Ultimate Passion, Essential Elegance) and offers bespoke packages; its event coordinator guides couples through local registry office requirements.

Eagles Resort (Halkidiki, near Mount Athos; Eagles Palace and Eagles Villas) has an official Meetings and Events page, titled 'Weddings & Corporate Events in Halkidiki', with a Weddings & Honeymoons section inviting couples to say 'I do' at the resort; its Theodora Conference Hall is 160 square metres for events of up to 150 guests (stated for corporate events).

insider_details.detail: Ikos Aria on Kos caps its wedding accommodation help at up to 30 guests, so a larger Australian guest list will need a second hotel or a written room block agreement before deposits.

Ikos Aria's own wedding page sends couples to the Greek consulate for civil wedding paperwork and warns requirements can change, so start translated documents early and have the Wedded Advisor confirm current requirements.

Miraggio in Halkidiki is one of the few resorts in this batch that publishes both a beach option and a ballroom option, which gives a built-in indoor alternative for a shoulder-season wedding; confirm the rain plan in writing.
The Poseidonion on Spetses publishes almost nothing beyond the fact it hosts weddings, so treat capacity, spaces and rooms as questions for the first enquiry call.

Nana Princess on Crete publishes recommended ceremony times by month (as late as 18:30 to 20:00 in July and August) because of heat, which is a useful rule of thumb for any Greek summer wedding: build the run sheet around an evening ceremony.
Nana Princess offers three ceremony types on one property (beach civil, Orthodox chapel, symbolic), which suits mixed families who want a religious rite without moving guests between venues.
